description.short: Chat with your Liftoff AI teams in Microsoft Teams.
description.full: Liftoff is an AI workforce management platform that lets companies design and deploy AI agents to run core business functions autonomously alongside their human workforce. In Microsoft Teams, mention @Liftoff in any chat or channel to talk to your AI teammates, hand off tasks, review their work, and get answers grounded in your connected tools and knowledge — just like messaging a coworker.
